title: BAE Falcon Works joint ventures with Lockheed Skunk Works
summary: Dylan Borland tells of BAE Falcon Works joint ventures with Lockheed Skunk Works, about unspecified at BAE Systems / Lockheed Martin, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: BAE has Falcon Works that is BAE's version of skunk works and BAE has joint ventures with Lockheed with skunk works on material sciences on engineering on engines on all of it.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says he worked at the defense company BAE Systems, says BAE has a unit called Falcon Works, its own version of Skunk Works, the secretive advanced aircraft division of the defense company Lockheed Martin. He says the two run joint projects on materials, engineering, engines and more, which, if true, would mean the two firms share their most advanced work.
